title: BrainPFN: Amortized Brain-Behaviour Prediction via Prior-Data Fitted Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.06934v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The standard approach to predicting behavioral phenotypes from functional MRI is represented by Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) applied on functional connectivity (FC) matrices. However, this approach is limited: separate models must be fit and tuned for every score and cohort, they do not transfer across datasets, and accuracy degrades sharply when only a handful of subjects are available, as is typical of clinical or cognitive studies. Despite an increasing interest in developing brain foundation models, none has consistently outperformed KRR on behaviour prediction; most reported gains come from easier targets such as age, sex, or diagnosis rather than continuous behavioural scores. We introduce BrainPFN, a Prior Data Fitted Network for brain behaviour regression. translated_title: BrainPFN：基于先验数据拟合网络的摊销式大脑-行为预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.06934v1 公告类型：交叉。从功能磁共振成像预测行为表型的标准方法是以在功能连接（FC）矩阵上应用核岭回归（KRR）为代表的。然而这种方法存在局限：必须为每个评分和队列单独拟合与调优模型，它们无法跨数据集迁移，而且当仅有少量受试者可用时——这在临床或认知研究中十分常见——准确度会急剧下降。尽管人们对开发大脑基础模型的兴趣日益增长，但尚无模型能在行为预测上持续超越KRR；大多数报告的性能提升来自更容易的目标，如年龄、性别或诊断，而非连续的行为评分。我们提出BrainPFN，一个用于大脑行为回归的先验数据拟合网络（Prior-Data Fitted Network）。BrainPFN在基于约7千个真实FC矩阵构建的领域特定先验上进行元训练，并从中采样了十亿个合成训练样本。在推理阶段，一个有标签的……
tldr: 提出BrainPFN——一种在由约7千个真实功能连接矩阵构建的领域先验上进行元训练的先验数据拟合网络，通过摊销式推断实现可跨数据集迁移、在小样本临床/认知场景下依然准确的大脑-行为预测，克服了核岭回归需逐评分调参、无法迁移的局限。
en_tdlr: BrainPFN is a Prior-Data Fitted Network meta-trained on a domain-specific prior built from ~7k real functional connectivity matrices, enabling amortized brain-behaviour prediction that transfers across datasets and remains accurate in small-sample regimes where Kernel Ridge Regression struggles.
